step1_analysis.description: A parallel RLC circuit driven by a current source. In the context of the paper, this typically models parasitic resonances in the power distribution network (PDN) or substrate coupling paths in mixed-signal ICs.

paper_reference.title: Methodology and Experimental Verification for Substrate Noise Reduction in CMOS Mixed-Signal ICs With Synchronous Digital Circuits

resonance_frequency.description: The frequency at which the parallel LC network resonates, resulting in maximum impedance and zero phase shift.

sky130_expected.calculation: f_res = 1 / (2 * pi * sqrt(L * C)). With L=2.533nH and C=10pF, f_res = 1 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Targeted to match the 1 GHz operating/oscillation frequency reported in the paper.

peak_impedance.description: The maximum AC impedance of the network, occurring at the resonance frequency.

sky130_expected.calculation: At resonance, the reactive components L and C cancel out, leaving only the parallel resistance RP.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Set to 50 ohms as a representative value for parasitic damping in a PDN or substrate model.

quality_factor.description: The Q factor of the resonator, defined as the ratio of resonance frequency to the -3dB bandwidth.

sky130_expected.reasoning: A low Q factor is typical for parasitic resonances in power and substrate networks due to significant resistive damping.

step3_testbench.description: AC analysis to measure the impedance profile, resonance frequency, peak impedance, and Q factor of the parallel RLC tank.
step3_testbench.spice:
* RLC Tank / PDN Impedance Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param R_val=50
.param L_val=2.533n
.param C_val=10p

* DUT Netlist
Isupply VDD VSS dc 0 ac 1
RP VSS VDD {R_val}
LP VSS VDD {L_val}
CP VSS VDD {C_val}

* Stimulus & Biasing
VVSS VSS 0 0

.control
ac dec 100 10Meg 10Gig

* Calculate impedance magnitude and phase
let z_mag = abs(v(VDD))
let phase = 180/PI * cph(v(VDD))

* Measure peak impedance and resonance frequency
meas ac z_max max z_mag
meas ac f_res when phase=0 fall=1

* Calculate -3dB bandwidth and Q factor
let z_3db = z_max / 1.41421356
meas ac f_low when z_mag=z_3db rise=1
meas ac f_high when z_mag=z_3db fall=1
let bw = f_high - f_low
let q_factor = f_res / bw

print z_max f_res bw q_factor
quit
.endc
